ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the regular hexagon $ABCDEF$, the diagonals $AC$, $BD$ intersect at point $M$. What is the value of $\frac{AM}{CM}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since hexagon ABCDEF is a regular hexagon, \\
$\therefore \angle BCD=\angle ABC=120^\circ$, AB=BC=CD, \\
$\therefore \angle BAC=\angle ACB=\angle CBD=\angle CDB=30^\circ$, \\
$\therefore CM=BM$, $\angle ABM=90^\circ$, \\
Let $BM=a$, then $CM=a$, \\
$\therefore AM=2BM=2a$, \\
$\therefore \frac{AM}{CM}=\frac{2a}{a}=\boxed{2}$.
